reader.requirement: At 85 a page footing's NEXT GROUP must (a) absolute: be greater than the line of the footing's final print line and not greater than PAGE LIMIT integer-1; (b) relative: added to that final line, not exceed integer-1; the compiler must refuse each violation. The witness covers the legal forms of a and b only.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 adds the §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR1 check (NEXT GROUP needs a LINE NUMBER clause in the group); the presentation-rule range checks after it take no edition branch
DialectLevel < 2002: the 85-only three-significant-digit limit on integer-1/integer-2 (§1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR2), checked before the range checks

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectLevel/Year in BindNextGroupClauses and MinimumLastLine: the page-footing cases and the page-limit check take no edition branch
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for this rule's limits; at 85 a page footing's first LINE clause must be absolute (Table 4 lists only 'A R'; refused separately as COBOL2199)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the legal forms of a and b (g85_f01_04); no refusal

probes.printed: COBOL2284 integer-1 17 shall be greater than the minimum last line number of the page footing (17)
probes.expected: refused: the final print line is 17 (GR4a)

probes.printed: COBOL2284 integer-1 21 exceeds the page limit 20
COBOL2284 minimum last line (17) plus integer-2 4 shall not exceed the page limit 20; PFREL03 EXIT 0
COBOL2199 the first LINE clause of a page footing is relative (§1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9); PFRLA18 and PFRLR03 also get COBOL2284 from the walked final line 18
COBOL2284 the NEXT PAGE phrase shall not be specified in a page footing

reader.notes: Every boundary of a and b is refused or accepted as the text requires: the page-limit half of a is the page-limit check (ng.Value > VerticalLimit), the other halves the PageFooting cases over MinimumLastLine. The diagnostics cite §2023:13.18.37.3 SR1/SR6c/SR7b, which state the same limits.

refuter.evidence: Tested the 'A R' sequence (LINE 16, LINE PLUS 2, final line 18; PAGE LIMIT 20, FOOTING 15). PFAA18 was refused COBOL2284 (not greater than 18) and PFAA19 accepted. PFAR2 (18+2=20) was accepted and PFAR3 (18+3=21) refused. MinimumLastLine walks absolute-then-relative lines correctly. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR4a.
